query:
ALTER TABLE coupons
  ADD COLUMN appliesToMembershipIds TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN minimumPurchaseAmount DECIMAL(12,2) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN firstTimeOnly BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

ALTER TABLE membership_members
  ADD COLUMN orgId INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN tierId INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN couponCode VARCHAR(64) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN discountAmount DECIMAL(12,2) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN renewsAt TIMESTAMP NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_coupons (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  couponId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_membership_coupon (membershipId, couponId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_bundle_items (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  resourceType ENUM('course','quiz','download','community','webinar','product') NOT NULL,
  resourceId INT NOT NULL,
  accessType ENUM('full','preview','timed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
  accessDays INT NULL,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_bundle_item (membershipId, resourceType, resourceId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_tiers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  billingInterval ENUM('monthly','quarterly','yearly','one_time') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
  trialDays INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stripeProductId VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  stripePriceId VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  features TEXT NULL,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_tier_items (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  tierId INT NOT NULL,
  resourceType ENUM('course','quiz','download','community','webinar','product') NOT NULL,
  resourceId INT NOT NULL,
  accessType ENUM('full','preview','timed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
  accessDays INT NULL,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_tier_item (tierId, resourceType, resourceId)
);
